info.title: AICTE Integrated Institution Complaint Monitoring and Coordination Portal
info.description: Multi-bureau grievance coordination, automated overlap detection, and institutional risk intelligence API.

post.description:
Authenticates AICTE officer credentials using bcrypt.
Enforces login rate limiting and returns signed PyJWT access token.
Generic error message returned on failure for security.

OAuth2 compatible token login for Swagger UI (/docs) Authorize button.
Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded form data with username (email) and password.
Shares identical bcrypt verification, rate limiting, and generic error message.

get.description: Returns public profile of currently authenticated AICTE officer.

Lists complaints with multi-parameter filtering, pagination, and RBAC scoping:
- Regional Officers are automatically scoped to their designated geographic region.
- Bureau Officers default to their assigned bureau (can be filtered).
- Senior Management and Admin possess global read-all access across all records.

post.description:
Ingests a new complaint into the AICTE portal:
1. Runs InstitutionResolutionEngine (Auto-link or flag Needs Review).
2. Calculates priority-adjusted SLA target disposal date.
3. Persists complaint and records initial ActionHistory audit entry.
4. Automatically runs overlap detection if resolved and creates CaseLink + Alerts.

get.description:
Returns full details for a complaint including chronological action history audit trail.
Verifies regional scoping for Regional Officers.

patch.description:
Updates status, priority, or remarks for a complaint.
Enforces Item 5: Officers may modify only complaints assigned to their own bureau.

post.description:
Transfers complaint to another bureau with an immutable audit log.
Enforces Item 5: Restricted to the assigning bureau, Admin, or Senior Management.

Escalates complaint to Senior Management with mandatory audit log.
Raises critical alert for leadership.

Confirms candidate institution match for complaints flagged for human review.
Enforces Item 3: Automatically runs overlap detection and creates CaseLink + Alerts.

Extracts structured governance metadata from raw complaint text:
- Extracts AICTE Permanent ID (format: 1-XXXXXXXXX).
- Extracts 6-digit postal pincodes.
- Resolves grievance category via concept normalization.
- Evaluates priority urgency signals.

Scenario 5: Real-time complaint intake pre-check.
Enforces Item 5 & Item 8:
1. Runs InstitutionResolutionEngine (AUTO_LINK, NEEDS_REVIEW, or UNRESOLVED).
2. If AUTO_LINK: runs overlap check against active cases at the resolved institution.
3. If NEEDS_REVIEW: runs overlap check against the top candidate institution,
   labelled 'provisional, institution not confirmed' (is_provisional = True).
4. If UNRESOLVED: returns no overlaps with explicit explanation.
5. STRICTLY DOES NOT PERSIST ANY ROWS TO THE DATABASE.

get.description:
Dynamic Institutional Risk Leaderboard (Scenario 6).
Evaluates institutions based on dynamic 5-component scoring computed from live DB records:
1. Complaint Volume (last 24m)
2. Pending Ratio
3. Severity Penalty
4. Repeat Categories Penalty
5. Unresolved Overlaps Penalty
Ranks institutions strictly by computed DB data without bias or hardcoding.

post.description:
Records an official officer decision on an inter-bureau overlap alert:
- Supported decisions: approved, rejected, needs_discussion, related_only.
- Sets designated final lead bureau if approved.
- Automatically appends audit history entries on BOTH involved complaint cases.

get.description:
Lists system notifications, SLA warning triggers, and overlap alerts.
Filters by user's assigned bureau for bureau-level officers.
Returns pagination metadata including total matching count.

patch.description: Marks an operational alert notification as read/acknowledged.

post.description:
On-demand execution of the AICTE statutory SLA compliance evaluation.
- Restricted to Admin and Senior Management.
- Evaluates every open complaint dynamically without hardcoding.
- Flags overdue cases and auto-escalates cases exceeding prolonged SLA threshold.
- Guaranteed idempotent: running multiple times does not produce duplicate alerts or escalations.
